text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - KV-cache eviction storm + continuous-batch latency surge in us-west-2. auto-created channel: #inc-2243509999. Severity: Sev2. Symptoms: sharp increase in batch timeouts, downstream 5xxs, paging pressure on kvcache.
arnold_oncall: acked. I'm paged and on it.
sara_eng: seeing sustained evictions in the kvcache metric (evictions/sec ~ 8x baseline) and cont-batch timeout rate spiking. Correlation with a config push?
jing_infra: noticed a recent cluster-wide deploy 2243508800 changed default continuous batch params via flag flip: max_batch_tokens=65536 -> 262144 and max_num_seqs default bumped to 2048 in the config map. Could be oversized batches starving the K/V paging layer.
kevin_runtime: whoa. that change would increase memory pressure on the kvcache and cause more paging. Also large batches increase latency variance which hits our per-request timeouts.
reena_sre: customer-facing impact: error rate up to 1.7% global in targeted region, tail (p99) token latency doubled for affected models. A few Dedicated customers reporting timeouts for high-concurrency routes.
arnold_oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) roll back the config bump to previous defaults in us-west-2 only (canary) 2) apply temporary backpressure throttle to cont-batch to cap max_batch_tokens to 65536 and max_num_seqs to 512 3) increase cont-batch soft timeout from 1.2s -> 2.5s to reduce thrash while caches stabilize 4) evict unhealthy backends from LB if mem pressure > threshold.
sara_eng: prepping hotfix manifest now. Will patch the config map and trigger a targeted rollout to the serving pool.
jing_infra: preflight checklist: apply to staging control plane -> patch nodepool config -> restart batch-workers gradually. Avoid global rollout to not ripple.
kevin_runtime: note: make sure we set disable_prefetch=true for the KV paging worker on the rollout to reduce parallel prefetch pressure.
ops-bot: deploy-request: author=sara_eng, env=us-west-2, change=cont-batch-config-reduce, plan=canary 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. linked-pr: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/cont-batch-config/pulls/118
arnold_oncall: executing plan now. sara, apply canary to 5% and share rollout id. I'll monitor evictions and batch timeouts.
sara_eng: canary started: rollout-id r-2243510123 -> applied to 5% worker pool.
reena_sre: monitoring: evictions/sec dropping in canary slice, cont-batch timeout rate down from 12% -> 3% in canary. Customer error rate in that slice back to baseline.
kevin_runtime: good sign. watching KV page-in rate too — it decreased ~60% in canary.
arnold_oncall: proceeding to 25% after 10m stable.
sara_eng: update: 25% done (r-2243510456). No new regressions.
ops-bot: deploy-status: canary->25% success.
reena_sre: region-level: overall error rate dropped from 1.7% -> 0.9% after 25%. Still above baseline but trending.
arnold_oncall: proceed 50% and plan to hold before 100%. If 50% stable for 15m, we'll promote to 100%.
jing_infra: added temporary autoscale guardrails to the kvcache layer: aggressive eviction backoff disabled for 30m, prefetch concurrency lowered.
kevin_runtime: we also pushed a runtime hotfix to add a per-worker soft limit that rejects overly-large batches earlier with a 429-friendly message so callers can backoff without causing kvcache thrash. Patch hash: abc1234.
sara_eng: 50% successful (r-2243510600). Holding 15m.
reena_sre: customer impact report: impacted routes reduced to 0.3% errors; a couple dedicated customers still seeing intermittent degradation—reached out to solutions-eng and CS with details.
arnold_oncall: after holding 15m, we're promoting to 100%.
sara_eng: rollout complete -> 100% (r-2243510822). Hotfix notes: set max_batch_tokens=65536, max_num_seqs=512, cont_batch_timeout=2.5s, disable_prefetch=true.
ops-bot: deploy-complete: changelist applied, post-deploy-tests passed.
reena_sre: final metrics: region error rate back to 0.08% (normal), p99 token latency within 1.1x baseline. kvcache evictions back to baseline.
arnold_oncall: incident control: mitigated. Next steps: 1) full rollback of the earlier unsafe default change from control plane commit 2243508800 (revert PR pending) 2) postmortem ownership: kevin_runtime to draft RCA 3) product/infra to add gating to config map changes that affect continuous batch defaults (require canary flag) 4) customer comms draft by CS and reena_sre.
kevin_runtime: will take RCA. Initial hypothesis: unguarded default increase for batch params caused resource amplification -> kvcache thrash -> paging storms -> tail latency spikes -> request timeouts.
sara_eng: saved the hotfix manifest: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/cont-batch-config/commits/patch-2243510822 and attached logs.
reena_sre: adding incident tag and creating postmortem doc. P0 followups: add metric alert for sudden mismatch between max_batch_tokens and available kvcache memory (new rule).
arnold_oncall: handing off to SRE for cleanup and RCA. I'll mark this thread resolved but keep watch for 1h. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-bot: marking incident resolved by arnold_oncall at 2243510945.
